sloka: एवम् उक्त्वा प्रदुद्राव रुदती शोक मूर्च्छिता ।शिरः च उरः च बाहुभ्याम् दुःखेन समभिघ्नती ॥४-१९-२०॥
transliteration: evam uktvā pradudrāva rudatī śoka mūrcchitā ।śiraḥ ca uraḥ ca bāhubhyām duḥkhena samabhighnatī ॥4-19-20॥

translations.english: So saying, the griefstricken, weeping Tara hastened, sadly beating with both hands her head and her chest.
